description: This is a Java test class for the OverlyDataCreatorForAndroid class, containing unit tests that verify the creation of overlay data based on theme colors and application info, using Robolectric and Mockito frameworks.

classes.name: OverlyDataCreatorForAndroidTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of OverlyDataCreatorForAndroid, focusing on theme color extraction and validation.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating a mock application context and the object under test.

methods.name: setupReturnedColors
methods.description: Mocks theme attributes to simulate different color themes for testing.

methods.name: testGetRawColorsHappyPath
methods.description: Verifies that overlay data is correctly created with expected colors for a valid theme.

methods.name: testAddsFullOpaqueToTextColor
methods.description: Checks that the primary text color is fully opaque when a transparent theme is used.

methods.name: testGetReferenceColorsHappyPath
methods.description: Verifies overlay data creation with reference color themes.

methods.name: testDoesNotFailIfMissingAttributeInTheme
methods.description: Ensures fallback behavior when theme attributes are missing.

methods.name: testReturnDarkAsPrimaryIfMissing
methods.description: Checks that dark primary color defaults to primary color if missing.

methods.name: testReturnsInvalidIfAppNotFound
methods.description: Verifies that overlay data is marked invalid when the application package cannot be found.
